__broaden__.quih: kij — its juice (inferred); written qu + i as Brasseur's quih, not q'ij 'day' · q'ij — (inferred) sun, day; in tikil q'ij 'noon', the planted sun (Brasseur gih, 'à midi précis'), written with plain qu where the house word is ꜫih; the toggle restores the q' · q'ij — day; ki q'ij 'their day', the day fixed for them (xchoye k'u kanoq ki q'ij 'their day was set'), written qui quih with plain qu; Brasseur reads qui gih · qui ih — (?) their back; qi- 'their' + ih 'back', in pu quih (U29); doubtful, Brasseur's print unclear
__broaden__.chah: chaj — torch; noun, a splinter of resinous pine; plays on chaaj 'play' · chaj — (inferred) ash, in the place name Pukb'al Chaj, after Brasseur ('le Cendrier'; his note gives chaah, with two a, as 'ash'); by the letters the same as the torch · chaj — (?) say, answer; verb of answering in xchi cu chah 'what will you say', after Brasseur
__broaden__.catoc: katok — you enter; k- + at 'you (one)' + ok 'enter' · katok — (?) we burn; cat 'burn' + -ok, in coh catoc 'when we burn'; not 'you enter'

__broaden__.quiy: kiy — (doubtful reading) grow, multiply; taken as ꜭiy (modern k'iy) with the letters as written, after Brasseur 'ils furent élevés' · kiy — (?) sweet (drink); in ca quiy 'our sweet drink', read with Brasseur's ka quiy
__broaden__.mich: mich — (inferred) pluck out; xu mich 'he plucked out' (Brasseur 'que celui-ci s'arracha'); the modern mich' 'pluck' is not restored · mich — (?) trick, make sport of; coh i mich 'you make sport of us', after Brasseur 'plaisanter'
